Every confirm() caller (reconcile.go:53/61/93, settle.go:79) leaves DB state unchanged on nil and retries; rounds.go:65,76 sets and deletes seconds with clients. TempoMinGas=2,262,000 matches live Tempo receipts (1,305,758/572,845 gas); at base fee 6e8 the floor is ~2,715 units ($0.0027). Base Sepolia pay hash in the record is a successful USDC transfer on chain. PROJECT.md D-15, architecture.md and money-safety.md match the code; F122-F125 match the record.
